title: Align Bill-to Name 2 editability with the other bill-to address fields on sales documents
summary: Bill-to Name 2 field on sales documents is now editable under the same conditions as other bill-to address fields when custom address is selected or customer differs from sell-to customer.
key_points: Bill-to Name 2 editability aligned with other bill-to address fields on four sales pages
Field now editable when Custom Address is selected or bill-to customer differs from sell-to customer
Previously editable only when Another Customer option was selected
Identical two-property change applied across all localization layers (APAC, BE, CH, ES, FR, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU)
Extended test coverage verifies editability alongside sibling address fields
